payload.title: Test Retina/Qwen visual seeds as UnifiedDB EAP ActiveAssembly anchors
payload.work_clay: Build a matched H1/proxy differential connecting current visual fixtures to the existing UnifiedDB Emergent Assembly Preprocessor. Produce provenance-bound PerceptualMemorySeed receipts from known/unknown/wrong/stale visual states, resolve only admissible current UnifiedDB refs, compile bounded EAP ActiveAssemblies, then compare QWEN_ONLY, QWEN_PLUS_DIRECT_EXACT_FTS_MEMORY, PAR_RAW_QWEN_SEED, PAR_PROJECTED_QWEN_SEED and EAP-guided active-sensing variants. Measure the complete sensor->seed->EAP->prompt->correct decision/action path rather than EAP microbench latency alone. Explicitly inject wrong high-confidence seeds, shuffled graph, stale epoch/hash, similar-looking changed identities, contradictory edges and unknown near-neighbors. Retrieved memory remains context-only and must never override current sensor evidence or mint GWT/effect authority.
payload.reason_clay: Existing UnifiedDB/EAP code already compiles epoch/hash-bound bounded ActiveAssemblies from seed refs and reports microsecond-class subpaths in synthetic tests. Q23 now researches whether native Qwen/MVC visual perception can supply those seeds before full semantic decode, creating a low-overhead associative memory reflex. The strongest counterrisk is confirmation bias: one false visual identity could activate coherent but wrong relational memory. A matched falsifier is required before any architecture promotion.
payload.completion_clay: A reproducible report with raw rows gives end-to-end p50/p95/p99 latency, seed-resolution cost, EAP-only cost, text/visual token cost, task/action correctness, memory precision/recall, false-familiarity, wrong-memory acceptance, sensor-override failures, false GWT ignition, crash/restart/replay and resource shadows. It must show whether PAR beats both QWEN_ONLY and the simpler direct-memory baseline and whether wrong-seed/shuffled/stale controls collapse the benefit. Disposition: SUPPORTED, REVISE, REFUTED or NO_CHANGE; no H1/H2/H3 release credit from implementation alone.
payload.executor_policy: Use existing q23/QNDRF visual fixtures and current EAP implementation where possible to avoid duplicate harness work. Keep the BASE ClayCode release critical path dominant; run this on spare/correctly matched capacity or when it directly informs H1 architecture. Do not call the path latency-free; report measured end-to-end latency. No paid training.
invalidators: A newer executed receipt already measures the same visual-seed EAP differential on current artifacts
Current Frank visual path can no longer produce stable evidence-bound entity/state seeds
